title: Debiasing Reward Models via Causally Motivated Inference-Time Intervention

bias_targets.methodology: Quantified by measuring the character-level length of responses to determine if reward models assign higher scores to longer texts regardless of helpfulness.
Quantified by counting the number of occurrences of paragraph breaks ('\n\n') in responses to measure preference for multi-paragraph formatting.
Quantified by calculating the ratio of common tokens contained in both the query and the response relative to the total number of tokens in the response.
Quantified by counting the number of exclamation marks ('!') in responses to measure preference for specific punctuation styles.
Quantified by counting the occurrences of markdown bold text indicators ('**') within responses to measure preference for text emphasis.
